translated_title: Mexicana Receives Its Ninth Embraer Aircraft; Increases Its Capacity by 11.04%
original_title: Recibe mexicana su noveno avión Embraer; incrementa 11.04% su capacidad
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
meta_description: Mexico's recently nationalized airline Mexicana receives its ninth Brazilian-built Embraer E2, raising monthly capacity to 57,020 seats out of the AIFA airport.
